class.name: end_effector_hardware/EndEffectorHardware
class.description: One end effector on a robot_comm bus (parameter bus: usb_rs485://..., arm_rs485://...), chosen by the parameter device: jodell_rg75, linkerhand_l6, xhand1.

class.name: end_effector_hardware/Kwr75Sensor
class.description: KWR75 six-axis force / torque sensor on a robot_comm bus (parameter bus: usb_rs485://..., arm_rs485://...), polled once per read() without waiting.

class.name: end_effector_hardware/GripperModbusHardware
class.description: Modbus ROS2 Control Hardware Interface Supports multiple Modbus-based end effectors (grippers, etc.) with different protocols. Currently supports: Jodell RG75 gripper (gripper_type: jodell)

class.name: end_effector_hardware/LinkerHandRs485Hardware
class.description: Modbus ROS2 Control Hardware Interface for Dexterous Hand Supports O7 mechanical hand via Modbus RTU protocol. Modbus ID: Right hand 0x27, Left hand 0x28 Baudrate: 115200 (fixed) Function codes: 04 (read), 16 (write)

class.name: end_effector_hardware/XHand1Rs485Hardware
class.description: ROS2 Control Hardware Interface for XHAND1 over its custom RS485 protocol. Defaults: /dev/ttyUSB0, hand ID 0, host ID 0xFE, baudrate 3000000, 8N1. Commands: 0x02 realtime 12-joint position control and feedback.

class.name: end_effector_hardware/Kwr75ForceTorqueSensor
class.description: KWR75 six-axis force/torque sensor over custom RS485 (USB-RS485 adapter). Defaults: /dev/ttyUSB0, baudrate 115200, 8N1, command 0x49. Poll command 0x49 0xAA 0x0D 0x0A, response 28-byte float frame.

class.name: end_effector_hardware/LinkerHandCanHardware
class.description: LinkerHand dexterous hand on classic CAN (1 Mbit/s), one hand per system; hand_type selects the model (linkerhand_l6). Left hand ID 0x28, right 0x27. Position feedback at 50 Hz, optional tactile.
